neighbours.label: the word desire or its pieces (des|ire, ' desire') and its Spanish form (des|eo)
fire: Their desire for revenge grew stronger every year.
Desire to travel led her far from home.
He spoke of a deep desire to return to the sea.
Un fuerte deseo de libertad movía a los jóvenes.
She felt no desire to speak with the press.
El deseo de vivir en paz es de todos.
It was the desire of the people to choose a king.
Su deseo de aprender era muy grande.
quiet: Their need for water grew stronger every year.
Hunger for gold led her far from home.
He spoke of a deep sadness at leaving the sea.
Un fuerte sentido de justicia movía a los jóvenes.
She felt no reason to speak with the press.
El derecho de vivir en paz es de todos.
It was the duty of the people to choose a king.
Su manera de aprender era muy buena.

notes: Card: 'eo' x7, ' desire' x7, 'iring' x6, 'ir' x5, 'ire' x3. Probes: 'ire' 0.832, ' desire' 0.545-0.657, 'eo' in deseo 0.609; 'Hunger' 0.002, 'la paz' 0.002. Near misses keep the frames with a different noun.
